name: Allium
description: An ornamental hardy bulbous perennial that sends up tall, sturdy stems topped with perfectly round, globe-shaped violet flowerheads made of dozens of tiny star-shaped blooms.
careInstructions: Thrives best in full sun and sharply well-drained, gritty soil. Water deeply after planting in autumn, then keep on the drier side to prevent bulb rot.

name: Alstroemeria
description: Also known as the Peruvian Lily or Lily of the Incas, this tuberous perennial produces terminal clusters of brilliant orange or golden-yellow, orchid-like striped flowers.
careInstructions: Prefers full morning sun with light afternoon shade. Requires fertile, consistently moist but well-drained soil. Pull spent stems from the base to promote new blooms.

name: Alyssum
description: Commonly called Sweet Alyssum, this low-growing, mat-forming annual produces dense, spreading mounds of tiny, highly fragrant white or purple flowers with a honey-like scent.
careInstructions: Best grown in full sun to partial shade in free-draining coastal or garden soil. Highly drought-tolerant once established. Shearing back by half after a flush encourages repeat blooming.

name: Amaranthus
description: Known as Love-Lies-Bleeding, this striking, erect annual features dramatic, long tassel-like drooping clusters of tiny crimson, petalless flowers over large light-green leaves.
careInstructions: Thrives in warm, sheltered environments with full sun exposure. Grows easily in average, moist, well-drained soil. May require staking or support as the heavy tassels mature.

name: Anemone
description: Commonly called the Poppy Anemone, this perennial produces striking, shallow cup-shaped poppy-like flowers in bold shades of red, blue, purple, or white with prominent dark central buttons.
careInstructions: Plant in rich, medium-moisture, well-drained soils under partial shade. Soak the hard, knuckle-like tubers in lukewarm water for a few hours before planting in the fall.
